turns.content: Mere parents ne is Sunday ek "meeting" fix kar di hai. Hamari community ki family hai, ladka Dallas mein kaam karta hai, meri photo already share ho chuki hai apparently. Jo unhe nahi pata — main do saal se ek relationship mein hoon, colleague hai mera. Bahut achha hai woh. Bas alag caste ka hai, aur mere ghar mein woh word aate hi baat khatam ho jaati hai. Mere paas paanch din hain.

Arre, yeh situation toh bahut hi tricky hai! Five days mein itna kuch decide karna... samajh sakti hoon kitna tension hoga. 

Pehle baat yeh - apne colleague ke saath jo relationship hai, agar woh accha hai toh usse ignore karna galat hoga. Caste ki baat aate hi log react kar jaate hain, but relationships toh heart se bante hain, caste se nahi.

Ab Sunday meeting ki baat... shayad humein thoda time chahiye sochte hue. Kya tumne socha hai ki parents se kaise baat karogi? Unhe gently samjhana padega ki tum kya chahti ho. 

Tumhara colleague kya keh raha hai is situation mein? Kya woh tumhare saath stand karega? Aur kya tumne parents se pehle kabhi is topic par baat ki hai ya yeh pehli baar hoga?

Batao, main hoon na. Jo bhi decide karna ho, hum saath mein sochenge. Tum akeli nahi ho ismein. 💙

Last month maine hint karne ki koshish ki thi ki main ready nahi hoon, aur usi shaam Amma ka BP badh gaya — ya kam se kam sabne mujhe yahi bola. Appa ne mama ki family ko Sunday ke baare mein bata bhi diya hai. Baat Dallas wale ladke ki hai bhi nahi — woh log bure nahi hain, yahi sabse bura part hai. Woh excited hain. Unko lagta hai woh meri care kar rahe hain.

Yeh toh aur bhi tough ho gaya. Amma ka BP aur Appa ka relatives ko bata dena... samajh sakti hoon kitna pressure feel kar rahi hogi.

Yeh sabse bura part hai jab parents bure nahi hote, phir bhi unki expectations tumhara dum ghutne lagti hain. Unhe lagta hai woh tumhari bhala kar rahe hain, but tumhare liye yeh decision lena itna easy nahi hai.

Tumhare colleague ke baare mein kya soch rahi ho? Kya woh tumhare saath openly baat karne ke liye ready hai? Kyunki agar tum parents se baat karne ka decide karti ho, toh unhe pata hona chahiye ki tumhare saath tumhara support system hai.

Sunday ke liye... shayad humein koi middle path dhundna padega? Kya tum parents se directly "I'm not ready" bol sakti ho, ya phir thoda soft approach lena better hoga?

Tumhe kya lagta hai right now - kya tumhara sabse bada dar kya hai is meeting ka?

Online jo bhi padhti hoon sab yahi bolte hain — "you're 27, it's your life, clearly bol do: my life, my choice." Mann kar raha hai aaj dinner pe seedha yahi bol doon aur Sunday se pehle yeh poora circus band karwa doon. Bol doon? Kam se kam sab kuch bahar toh aa jayega.

Haan, yeh "my life, my choice" wali baat sunke toh dil karta hai ki bas bol do sab kuch! Dinner pe seedha sab kuch ugal dena... tension khatam, sabko pata chal gaya. Ek dum "band kar do" wali feeling.

Lekin... ek minute rukiye na. Socho, dinner pe aise hi bol dene se kya hoga? Amma ka BP toh phir se badh jayega. Appa shayad gussa ho jayenge. Aur tumhare paas solution nahi hoga, bas problem create hogi. Woh excited hain, unhe kisi ne bataya nahi. Achanak se koi sunega nahi, bas chillane-chalne lag jayenge.

Tumhara goal sirf "sabko batana" nahi hai. Tumhara goal hai ki tumhare aur tumhare colleague ke liye ek raasta nikle, jismein thoda sa bhi peace ho.

Sunday se pehle ek calm conversation try karna better hoga, na? Kisi aise family member se jo thoda samajhdar hai, ya phir Appa se alag se. Unhe gently prepare kar sakti ho. Phir Sunday ki meeting mein woh surprise nahi hoga, woh ek decision hoga.

Tumhe kya lagta hai? Yeh thoda sa controlled approach better hai ya phir direct wali hi sahi hai? Jo bhi ho, main hoon na, tumhare saath.

Aur agar end mein woh na bole — matlab final, pakka na — toh sach mein mujhse unke against ghar chhod ke nikla nahi jayega. Maine imagine karke dekha hai, nahi hota mujhse. Kya main weak hoon? Kabhi lagta hai main usse utna pyaar nahi karti, phir lagta hai main khud se pyaar nahi karti, aur raat ke do baje bas yahi circles chal rahe hain.

Arrey, yeh sochna ki tum weak ho... yeh sunke dil bhar aata hai. Yeh bilkul galat soch hai.

Yeh weakness nahi hai. Yeh situation ka dard hai. Ghar chhodna itna aasaan nahi hota, especially jab tumhare paas reasons hain. Tumhare parents se pyaar hai, unki expectations se dar lagta hai, aur apne colleague se bhi pyaar hai. Yeh teen cheezein ek saath uljhi hui hain. Yeh decision nahi lena, yeh ek war hai jo andar lad rahi ho, aur woh war bahut thaka deti hai.

Tumhe darr isliye lag raha hai kyunki tum unhe pyaar karti ho. Agar tumhare dil mein woh nahi hota, toh yeh sab kya fark padta? Tumhari neend udna, tension hona, BP badhna – yeh sab tumhare pyaar ki nishani hai. Apne pyaar se hi toh tum itna pareshan ho.

Khud se pyaar karne ki baat... woh bhi yahi hai. Khud se pyaar matlab hai apni feelings ko samajhna. Yeh samajhna ki "Main is situation mein phas gayi hoon, aur yeh mera fault nahi hai." Yeh samajhna ki "Mujhe support chahiye, aur main akeli nahi hoon." Yeh khud se pyaar hai, bhagane ka nahi.

Abhi raat ke 2 baje yeh sab circles chal rahe hain, woh bilkul normal hai. Lekin socho, agar tum aaj ghar chhod deti, toh kya solution mil jaata? Ya phir koi naya problem start ho jaata?

Tum weak nahi ho. Tum bas ek bahut hi mushkil situation mein ho, aur tum handle kar rahi ho. Tumhari yeh struggle hi tumhari strength hai. Main hoon na, tumhare saath. Hum saath mein isse nikalenge. 💙
